name: Temporal Focus removes a banish on application (#544)
contract: Temporal Focus 806165 is three SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_IMMUNITY (77) effects with EffectMiscValue 9 (MECHANIC_SILENCE), 26 (MECHANIC_INTERRUPT) and 18 (MECHANIC_BANISH) - exactly the three the tooltip names - and AttributesEx 0x8000 = SPELL_ATTR1_IMMUNITY_PURGES_EFFECT, which is the 'removing' half. No script is needed: AuraEffect::HandleModMechanicImmunity calls SpellInfo::ApplyAllSpellImmunitiesTo, which registers IMMUNITY_MECHANIC and, for a purging immunity, calls Unit::RemoveAurasWithMechanic over the same mask. Banish 710 carries Mechanic 18, so applying Temporal Focus must strip it. 806165 also has AttributesEx5 0x8 (SPELL_ATTR5_ALLOW_WHILE_STUNNED), which is what lets it be cast while banished. The silence and interrupt clauses use the identical code path with EffectMiscValue 9 and 26 and are not exercised separately: a fixture aura carrying either mechanic can only be placed before the cast, and a silence would then block the cast itself. DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms.

steps.label: The banish is on the Chronomancer before the cast
Applying Temporal Focus removes the banish
Temporal Focus lasts the record's 10 seconds
